measurement: full-global controller update including outbound TextInput.setEditingState enqueue -> endOfFrame; excludes native event queue, channel completion and actual present
processRssMeaning: cumulative process resident set; same process/all prior fixtures; not per-document delta
painterCacheLimitMeaning: at most 32 warm painters plus active scene leases; scene pages cannot be evicted until next scene build
frameTimingPartition: Callback arrival phase, with 120ms drain after input and scroll. Delayed FrameTiming callbacks can cross phase boundaries; raw frame number/timestamps retained. Not input-to-present.
limitations: Full raw native value remains O(document length) channel payload
Distant caret or scroll into an unmeasured long paragraph synchronously resolves its prefix; reported separately and in scroll samples
Offscreen paragraph heights are estimates until visited; full document geometry is not claimed ready at load
Soft-page bidi/context shaping may differ from a full paragraph
No production persistence, undo memory cap, screen-reader audit or native IME certification
